purpose: Approved-source registry for controlled RALA provenance ingestion.
source_acceptance_rules: Only authoritative public/government, manufacturer, or TorqueMind-authored reviewed content.
No development fixtures, scraped web copies, or unlicensed manuals.
Each source must include checksum, storage path, license metadata, and review notes.
Each chunk must include page or section locators and a SHA-256 text hash.
Pilot data must remain draft until reviewed and explicitly approved.
